summary: Retest after fixes: ALL prior regressions PASS and both flagged frontend layout bugs are RESOLVED. Backend pytest: 33/33 pass in 19.77s — health, projects CRUD, files CRUD, run (py/js/ts via tsx/html/css), timeout, chat stream+history+clear, snippets CRUD, star toggle idempotency, is_starred, delete authorship guard (403) + cascade. Frontend @ 390x844: (a) SnippetDetailModal 'Insert at Cursor' button now bbox y=791, height=40 → y+h=831 ≤ 844 (in viewport, previously ~1635). (b) PublishModal 'Publish' submit button also bbox y=791, y+h=831 ≤ 844 (fully reachable). (c) Insert-at-Cursor end-to-end verified: opened Fibonacci python snippet detail sheet → tapped detail-insert-btn → navigated back to `/` → visible editor textarea (data-testid=code-input) contains 112 chars including 'def fib(n):', 'return fib(n-1) + fib(n-2)', AND preserved original 'print(\'Hello from Syntax IDE\')' (staged pending_insert applied after refreshProjects, exactly per fix note). (d) No new regressions: Find bar opens & closes; python 'print(...)' run returns stdout 'Hello from Syntax IDE'; AI Assistant screen loads with chat-input + chat-send-btn testIDs (chat streaming already covered by pytest test_chat_stream and test_history_after_chat which persist and return >=1 message). Minor issue: duplicate mounts of the code editor result in TWO DOM textareas both carrying data-testid='code-input' — the first is hidden and stale, the second visible and authoritative. Also carried-over: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' console warning.

ui_bugs.issue: Two DOM textareas share data-testid='code-input' — first is hidden with stale text (offsetWidth=0, length 31), second visible with fresh text (length 112). Likely a stale unmount/duplicate render of the editor when returning from another route. Not user-facing but breaks single-element testID contract and could indicate a memory/state leak. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:635 (testID='code-input').

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — carried over from iteration 1 & 2, still present. Reference: any component passing pointerEvents as prop (grep for 'pointerEvents=' in /app/frontend/app/).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Investigate why two [data-testid='code-input'] textareas exist in the DOM at the same time. Likely a leftover mount from the previous focused-file (fast route re-focus). Ensure the editor unmounts cleanly or key the TextInput by fileId so only one instance is present.
OPTIONAL: Replace deprecated `pointerEvents` prop with `style.pointerEvents` to silence the console warning (react-native-web migration).

pending_insert race fixed via ref staging in useFocusEffect + follow-up useEffect([loading, activeFileId]) — verified end-to-end insertion into the editor after route change.
